# OpenTac

OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing

**2026-10-22 · Preprint · Johns Hopkins University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31661)** · [Project](https://opentac.github.io/) · [Code](https://github.com/opentac/opentac)

An open flex-PCB tactile ecosystem combines custom CAD, shear-sensitive bumps, reusable readout, simulation, transfer and policy-learning examples.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/opentac-benchmark.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 1 : Tactile samples recorded with OpenTac skins. Heatmaps indicate normal load; cyan arrows denote per-bump shear; white arcs denote rotation estimates. (a) 64×64 skin, twisting a dome and clippers. (b) 9×9 fingertip, opposite thumb twists. (c) UMI gripper, 29×6 finger skins: can and ball rocked in the grasp. (d) Extrinsic contact: screwdriver moved down and up."/>
